ambiguities.text: Cells S: 'A0 = production + lower-tail mixture ... B = A0 + 27 columns appended through stat_feature_names'
ambiguities.reading: A0 is the stored-components mixture arm (3.140236 / 3.176840 for pts). B, the placebo, the knockouts and the no-tracking arm are the production model with extra columns, passed through the SAME lower-tail mixture (A0's stored row mixing weights `row_pi` and per-block quantile weights `wq_*`), so every S arm is on the mixture support. Raw (non-mixture) production is not an arm.

ambiguities.text: Cell P comparator C = 'P1 (M2-p) + the report-tag-by-strength and morning/evening flags of PPLAY_CONTEXT (`build_terms`, without the b2b-habit terms)'
ambiguities.reading: C = BASE_FEATURES + TERM_TAG['T-60'] (terc, tag60_code, q60, d60, q60_x_terc, d60_x_terc) + TERM_REPORT (on_morning_report, on_evening_report). The b2b-habit terms team_b2b_sit, star and b2b_star are NOT in C or W.

ambiguities.text: Placebo: 'the arm beats its family placebo by a point <= -0.003 (props, P) / -0.05 min (minutes)'
ambiguities.reading: One placebo arm (all 27 columns permuted: LOAD within player-season, SCHEDULE and TRAVEL within team-season). The condition is judged on the REPORT season 2024 (B - PL <= margin); 2023 is reported. Per-family placebos are not run.

ambiguities.text: Pass rule 4: 'if removing one family removes >= 80% of the gain, or one family alone keeps >= 80%'
ambiguities.reading: Gains are 2024 mean differences vs the base. Removal arms (KO_LOAD, KO_SCHEDULE, KO_TRAVEL) run for every cell in `arms`; the 'family alone' arms (AL_*) run in `attack` for cells that pass rules 1-3 only. Flag 'one family carries it' = any KO leaves <= 20% of the full gain OR any AL keeps >= 80%.

ambiguities.text: 'LOAD-without-tracking (LOAD_MIN only)' and 'A tracking claim needs LOAD(full) - LOAD_MIN <= floor/2 on the same rows'
ambiguities.reading: NT = the full candidate minus the 7 LOAD_TRACK columns (LOAD_MIN, SCHEDULE and TRAVEL stay). Tracking claim holds when 2024 mean(B - NT) <= floor/2 for the cell. Descriptive unless a cell otherwise passes.

ambiguities.text: Pass rule 3: 'the arm does not beat its own oracle bound (A3 for props, realised minutes for M)'
ambiguities.reading: Props: B's 2024 mean CRPS must exceed the stored A3 (production + realised minutes, reports/minutes_v2/props_<stat>_A3.npz) mean on the same season. P and M: not applicable (an oracle for realised minutes is zero CRPS; for P(play) the realised outcome); recorded as n/a, not as a pass.

Labels permuted within the training set of each month block (props: residuals; P: played flag; M: minutes). MDE is the half-width of the cell's own 2024 B-vs-base CI. Shuffled arm passes if its 2024 mean effect >= -MDE.

ambiguities.text: Star slice 'as-of top-3 team minutes per appearance over 10 games'
ambiguities.reading: Slice only (never a feature): the three highest as-of `min10` (cell P: avg minutes given played) among the scored rows of the team-game. Starter = as-of start rate >= 0.5 (starter10; cell P starter_rate_prior).

ambiguities.text: M2 reproduction tolerance (the rule requires A0 to reproduce; M2 and C are new fits)
ambiguities.reading: M2 (refit here) is compared with the stored reports/minutes_v2/minutes_scores.npz M2 CRPS on the rows both have (stored 2024 has 27,583 rows, the data now 27,701, so the comparison is on the key intersection, >= 99% of rows required): 2023 within 1e-6 min, 2024 within 0.005 min (PPLAY_CONTEXT's frozen amendment for the 12-game data clean-up). A failure stops `arms` before any candidate arm is fitted. C has no stored reference and is not reproduced.

Rule 1 for 2023 has no BH requirement; for 2024 BH p <= 0.05 over the six primary cells {P, M, pts, reb, ast, fg3m} (candidate vs base), computed within each season. Two-sided clustered-bootstrap p (2000 draws, seed 0, cluster = game_id).

ambiguities.text: Planted tests and missingness audit 'on the frozen frames'
ambiguities.reading: `gate` audits the 55,320 A0 rows (props/minutes rows) and the cell-P rows (including DNP as its own bucket) with threshold max(2 pp, 3 x placebo); planted same-game / planted-future tests run on the REAL played table with non-inert controls. Any failure stops everything (kill criterion).
Descriptive only: DraftKings T-60 legs (nba.markets.decision_scoring) re-priced with each S cell's A0 and B integer grid. Errors are recorded, never fatal.

ambiguities.text: D3 oracle-minutes pair for pts and reb
ambiguities.reading: A3 = A0 features + realised minutes (`minutes_oracle`) and A3W = A3 + 27 columns, both through the mixture; the verdict line is 'effect runs through minutes' if B beats A0 but A3W - A3 > floor/2, else flagged.
